raw: {"diagnosis": "LBBB", "stemi": "no", "rationale": "The QRS is wide (≥120 ms), with deep QS/rS complexes in V1–V3 and broad, notched, monophasic R waves in I, V5 and V6 with no septal q waves, which is classic LBBB; the ST elevation in V1–V3 runs opposite to the QRS and is in proportion to it, so it is expected secondary repolarization and does not meet Sgarbossa or STEMI criteria."}
